title: DevinDispatchOutput
description: Structured output every Devin session in this dispatcher must return.

outcome.description: pr_opened: you opened a PR you stand behind. investigated_no_action: you looked but chose not to PR. blocked: you couldn't proceed (state why in summary).

pr_url.description: Full URL of the PR you opened. Null if outcome != pr_opened.

summary.description: 1-3 sentence honest summary of what you did, what worked, and what didn't.
